name: Joshua Gore
story: Joshua Gore worked as a GIS Developer on Eagle Technology’s LocalMaps product. A graduate profile describes troubleshooting, product development, Esri integration and web GIS work, placing him in the development layer behind a locally produced council-facing mapping application.
